snippet.title: Sid Meier's Civilization (1991) - DOS Gameplay Video (PC MS-DOS)
snippet.description:
Get the Game For Free Here → https://goo.gl/LJHWPH

Release Date: 1991
Developer: MicroProse Software
Publisher: MicroProse Software
Game Type: Turn Based Strategy

Not much needs to be said about a game that was released 25 Years ago and is still churning out new versions of itself. 

Civilization capture many people of my generation and with it's new iteration I'm sure it managed to do the same for others. The one more turn syndrome was a plague on many gamer's sleep.
